data.one_liner: A helper library for command-line applications requiring advanced control over input/output.
data.what_it_does: Provides control over console window dimensions, cursor location, colors, raw input mode, and tabular data display. It includes features for reading control sequences, handling East Asian character widths, and streaming key input asynchronously.
use_when: Building command-line applications or REPLs in Dart
Needing raw keyboard input processing or cursor manipulation
Displaying formatted tabular data or calendars in the terminal
avoid_when: Developing graphical user interface (GUI) or mobile applications
strengths: Supports raw terminal mode and advanced keyboard input processing
Cross-platform support for Windows, macOS, and Linux
Includes built-in support for table rendering and calendar display
weaknesses: Requires a terminal that recognizes and implements common ANSI escape sequences
Platform-specific bindings rely on FFI and the win32 package on Windows
